From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantumsight.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — marketplace listing & discount conversation

Hi Ethan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at QuantumSight is excited about Redwood’s latency and cost profiles. We’re getting internal buy-in for a pilot but need to get the pricing and marketplace path clarified so procurement can greenlight the pilot.

Two asks to start:
- Can Redwood publish a Private Offer in AWS Marketplace for a 12-month pilot with a 30% off-list sticker? Procurement asked for that level to match projected ARR needs.
- Can we get a short-term co-sell credit or marketplace marketing support tied to the pilot (Q3) so our internal buying committee classifies this as a vendor-managed offer?

I’ve attached a draft SOW and an initial volume estimate (QSI_SOW_v3.pdf, qsi_pricing_proposal.xlsx). If we can align quickly, procurement is happy to proceed with DocuSign for a private offer.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Strategic Partnerships
QuantumSight Inc.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Deal desk request — QuantumSight private offer / variance ask (QSI-2027-1157)

Ben / Karthik —

Requesting a marketplace pricing variance and co-sell credit alignment for QuantumSight (deal QSI-2027-1157). Summary below and attached proposal: qsi_pricing_proposal.xlsx, redlines_contract.docx.

Summary:
- Requested listing discount: 30% off list for 12-month private offer (pilot -> renewal)
- Requested co-sell credit: 10% of first-year ARR to be applied as marketplace marketing/co-sell budget (QuantumSight expects $420k first-year ARR if pilot converts)
- Rationale: high strategic potential in finance vertical, committed pilot with named references, AWS co-sell motion may accelerate adoption.
- Risks: margin compression; will set precedent for small-mid enterprise private offers.

Proposed mitigation (what sales is willing to accept):
1) Limit the variance to a single private offer tied to Deal ID QSI-2027-1157, not generalizable.
2) 12-month minimum spend commitment confirmed in SOW.
3) Redwood receives co-marketing commitments (1x webinar, 1x case study) and a named reference.
4) If QSI fails to convert to the minimum ARR at renewal, discount recapture clause in redlines_contract.docx.

Ask: Ben — can Deal Desk approve a one-off pricing variance + commit to a co-sell credit structure? If full 30% is not acceptable, what’s the floor we can offer while preserving a path to win the pilot?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: qsi_pricing_proposal.xlsx, redlines_contract.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal desk request — QuantumSight private offer / variance ask (QSI-2027-1157)

Marissa / Ethan —

Thanks for the detailed ask and the mitigation plan. I reviewed the numbers and conferred with finance. We can approve a constrained variance with the following commercial constraints:

Approved path (conditional):
- Marketplace private offer discount: 20% off list (one-off for QSI-2027-1157)
- Co-sell credit: up to 5% of first-year ARR to reimburse co-sell/marketing activities; additional 5% contingent on meeting a named-reference milestone within 9 months.
- Minimum committed ARR: $300k in the first 12 months (contracted in SOW).
- Recovery clause: if committed ARR not met at renewal, Redwood reserves right to invoice the net difference (see attached redlines_contract.docx).
- Timebox: offer expires if not executed in 21 days; this avoids open-ended precedent.

Operational asks for marketplace/private offer flow:
1) Legal to approve redlines_contract.docx (I’ve attached suggested edits).
2) Product/ops to confirm that the private offer can be created in AWS for a 20% sticker and that the marketplace listing will not require a separate SKU. Karthik — can you loop in the AWS Marketplace PM and confirm feasibility?
3) Sales to request DocuSign link and finalize SOW signatures.

If QSI agrees, we’ll produce a short internal canary plan: 30-day pilot performance check with an automatic escalation to ABE if metrics are missed. That protects net unit economics.

Ben
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

- Minimum committed ARR: $300k.
- Docs: redlines_contract.docx contains the recovery clause and timebox; qsi_pricing_proposal.xlsx attached for final numbers.

Next steps for rapid execution (action items):

- Marissa / Ben / Karthik: I’ll coordinate with Legal to finalize redlines and get DocuSign queued.
